behavior.recovery_scope: 54 static group labels mix reset-selected lessons; not original_chain-only success.

stationary_10s.scope: Windows completed in these rollouts; an anchor may precede the interval.

dynamic_lessons.fraction_scope: Time-averaged instantaneous lesson success/population; not ended-episode success rate.

learning_ownership.scope: Only policy_learning_mask-valid transitions can learn; other physical frames include SCRIPT/BLEND/passive birth.

ordinary_posture_coverage.scope: Frozen4ba startup population: translation/transitions/yaw legacy aliases are excluded from ordinary posture; base catalog coverage is not perturbation coverage.

optional_conditional_stop_phases.scope: Native braking/settled_stop-mask physical samples, weighted by samples; whole start-stop motion is not parking.

optional_posture_reward_density.scope: Reward densities/costs, not measured pitch/roll angles.
